notes.plant_leucobryum_glaucum: Cushion moss, prefers acidic conditions. In closed systems needs an active springtail colony and periodic ventilation.
notes.plant_dicranum_scoparium: Cushion moss, prefers acidic conditions. In closed systems needs springtails and ventilation.
notes.plant_climacium_dendroides: Tree-like moss. Needs a cool winter rest.
notes.plant_nephrolepis: In small volumes quickly hits the lid; needs trimming.
notes.plant_adiantum: Sensitive to drying out and direct rays.
notes.plant_pellaea_rotundifolia: Rock fern, light-loving. Not for sealed jars.
notes.plant_davallia: Furry rabbit-foot rhizomes creep over the surface.
notes.plant_fittonia: A classic for closed florariums. Pinch for compactness.
notes.plant_pilea: Can be aggressive in small volumes.
notes.plant_peperomia: Semi-succulent: dislikes waterlogging and leaf condensation.
notes.plant_ficus_pumila: Aggressive vine: covers everything in 2–3 months, trim regularly. Milky sap is toxic.
notes.plant_soleirolia_soleirolii: Very aggressive carpet: crowds out moss in 1–3 L jars.
notes.plant_biophytum_sensitivum: Leaves fold when touched. A mini palm.
notes.plant_begonia_rex_etc: Ventilated systems only. Dislikes leaf condensation.
notes.plant_episcia: Spreads by runners, quickly fills the volume.
notes.plant_calathea_maranta_ctenanthe: Needs ventilation. Sensitive to hard water and dry air (spider mites).
notes.plant_strobilanthes_dyerianus: Large for small jars: hits the lid. Metallic purple under bright light.
notes.plant_hydrocotyle: Very fast carpet, loves wet substrate.
notes.plant_tradescantia: Fast growth, easy to propagate from cuttings.
notes.plant_epipremnum_scindapsus: Large vine for small jars. Toxic.
notes.plant_marcgravia: Shingle leaves pressed to the mount. Closed warm systems only.
notes.plant_hedera_helix: Temperate climate, needs wintering. Rots in sealed jars.
notes.plant_macodes_petola: Needs stable humidity and warmth. Cannot tolerate condensation.
notes.plant_anoectochilus: Needs stable humidity and warmth. Cannot tolerate condensation.
notes.plant_dossinia_marmorata: Needs stable humidity and warmth. Cannot tolerate condensation.
notes.plant_goodyera: Temperate climate, needs a cool winter rest.
notes.plant_mini_epiphytes_orchids: Ventilated systems only, mounted on wood.
notes.plant_tillandsia: Atmospheric: no substrate. Soak 20–30 min every 1–2 weeks or mist 2–3 times a week.
notes.plant_cryptanthus: Moisture-loving bromeliad but cannot tolerate condensation.
notes.plant_neoregelia: Pour water into the rosette cup.
notes.plant_guzmania_vriesea: The rosette dies after flowering; keep the offsets.
notes.plant_drosera: Acid peat without fertilizer only, distilled water. Dew forms under bright light.
notes.plant_pinguicula: Sticky leaves catch gnats. Acid substrate, distilled water.
notes.plant_dionaea_muscipula: Open/semi-open only, bright sun, cool winter rest. Distilled water.
notes.plant_nepenthes: Needs a day/night drop for pitchers. Expert level.
notes.plant_haworthia: Shade-tolerant succulent: can grow without a lamp, but slowly.
notes.plant_rhipsalis: Forest cactus: loves humidity, unlike desert cacti.
notes.fauna_collembola: Ecosystem foundation: eat mold and litter. Establish 1–2 weeks before planting.
notes.fauna_trichorhina_tomentosa: Dwarf isopods, do not burrow deep.
notes.fauna_millipedes: Burrow and mix layers. Release benzoquinones when stressed — do not combine with small fauna.
notes.fauna_land_snails: Pest: eats live plants, parthenogenetic (breeds without a mate).
notes.fauna_earthworms: Not recommended for closed systems: destroy layers and die.
notes.fauna_entomopathogenic_nematodes: Parasitize gnat larvae. Applied with watering.

prep.boil_or_bake: Boil 20–30 min or bake in the oven
prep.isolate_from_soil: Isolate from substrate (barrier/sealant) so it does not raise pH

basalt.notes: Inert, dark; for taiga and jungle.

slate.notes: Flat layers for mountains; smooth sharp chips.

ohko.notes: Dragon stone: rinse clay pockets, fragile.

volcanic.notes: Porous lava: rinse dust, holds moisture.

river_pebbles.notes: Smooth, safe for fauna; carbonate test.

quartz.notes: Inert white; for minimalism and stream beds.

quartz_sand.notes: Inert; paths, stream beds, top dressing.

concrete.notes: Strongly alkaline: isolate from substrate, neutral species only.

marble.notes: Alkaline: only with succulents and tolerant species.

lemezit.notes: Marbleized limestone: alkaline, not for moss or carnivores.

coquina.notes: Shell limestone: alkaline, not for acid-lovers.

seiryu.notes: Calcite veins raise pH/KH; test, not for moss.

travertine.notes: Carbonate: alkaline; for ruins with neutral species.

driftwood.notes: Boil/bake; tannins slightly acidify. Mount for epiphytes.

cork_bark.notes: Cork bark: mount for epiphytes, does not rot.

alder_cones.notes: Alder cones: tannins, acidify, food for cleanup crew.

oak_litter.notes: Oak litter: food for cleanup crew, refresh 4–8 weeks.

tropical.notes: Light moisture-retentive mix for tropics; no fertilizer.

epiphytic.notes: Bark and sphagnum for epiphytes; pockets and mounting.

carnivore_acid.notes: High-moor peat without fertilizer plus perlite/quartz only; distilled water.

moss_acid.notes: Acid peat and sphagnum; for bog mosses.

charcoal.notes: Granular horticultural/wood charcoal, not pharmacy tablets.

taiga_wabikusa.name: Taiga / wabi-kusa
taiga_wabikusa.mood: Mossy forest: mounds, driftwood, asymmetry and height contrast.
taiga_wabikusa.tips: Dark stones (slate, granite, lava), moss carpet, one vertical accent. Avoid symmetry.

tropical_jungle.name: Tropical jungle
tropical_jungle.mood: Dense greenery in 3+ layers, vines and epiphytes; no empty gaps.
tropical_jungle.tips: Carpet ≥50% of floor, bushes, vines on the background, epiphytes on wood. Ohko and lava stones.

iwagumi_rocky.name: Iwagumi / rocks
iwagumi_rocky.mood: Mountain stones and low carpets; one stone type, at most 3 plants.
iwagumi_rocky.tips: One stone type, carpet ≥70%, no vines. The stone is the hero.

forest_stream.name: Forest stream
forest_stream.mood: A path or stream between banks with ferns and mosses.
forest_stream.tips: Quartz sand and pebbles for the bed, ferns on the banks, sphagnum by the water.

ruins_postapo.name: Ruins / post-apocalyptic
ruins_postapo.mood: Brick and concrete reclaimed by greenery; story and texture.
ruins_postapo.tips: Soak brick and terracotta, isolate concrete. Vines and carpet wrapping the ruins.

minimal_modern.name: Minimal / modern
minimal_modern.mood: Clean layers, geometry, 1–3 plants and one stone.
minimal_modern.tips: One accent species, clean top dressing, no aggressive carpets or burrowing fauna.

bowl_small.best_for: Succulents and minimalism on a windowsill.

jar_5l.best_for: Mini jungle with fauna; height headroom.

jar_tall.best_for: Vines and vertical accents; has height.

bottle.best_for: Closed expert jar; plant with tweezers.

sphere.best_for: Hanging micro build; micro species only.

recommend.volume: Volume {volume} L fits (needs at least {min_volume} L).
recommend.footprint: Floor of {footprint} cm² fits your planting.
recommend.closure: The lid supports the selected system type.
recommend.height: Height above substrate is enough for the selected species.
recommend.starter_bonus: Starter size — convenient for a first jar.
recommend.no_fit: No vessel fits the build: lacking {constraint}. Choose a larger vessel.

condensation.normal: light fogging in the morning, glass clear by noon
condensation.over_action: leave the lid ajar 2–4 hours (overnight for heavy overwatering)
condensation.under_action: add 30–50 ml water per 3 L and recheck after a day

ventilation.closed_schedule: 1–2 hours a week with the lid ajar
ventilation.semi_schedule: short daily airing or a mesh lid
ventilation.mold_prevention: springtails and ventilation; charcoal removes odors but does not stop mold

water.closed_initial_moistening: substrate moist like a wrung-out sponge
water.open_tropical_check: top 1–2 cm dry — water at the roots
water.carnivore_water_closed: constantly moist, no standing water at the roots

placement.south_shaded: the best spot for closed jars
placement.south_direct: a closed jar will overheat — not allowed
placement.room_depth: low light; most species need a lamp
placement.lamp_only: level set by distance and hours
